_description: Response body returned by GET /api/model/active-learning-status — a real-time snapshot of the active-learning cycle state, retrain progress, and model file health.

_notes.cycleActive: True only when a trained model is available. False on fresh startup or after a catastrophic training failure.
_notes.totalRetrainingRuns: In-memory counter reset to zero on application restart.
_notes.lastRetrainedAt: Null if no automatic retraining run has completed since the application started.
_notes.claudeLabelledSinceLastRetrain: In-memory counter reset to zero after each automatic retraining run. Incremented each time the Claude oracle is consulted.
_notes.totalUnlabelled: Reviews in the database that have no label yet — i.e. submitted before the model was trained.
_notes.modelFileExists: Checks the filesystem at modelStoragePath at the time of the request.

_variant_cycle_active_midway._comment: Normal running state — model trained, 70% of the way to next automatic retrain.

_variant_retrain_just_triggered._comment: Retrain just completed — counter reset to zero, run count incremented.

_variant_untrained_fresh_deployment._comment: Fresh deployment — no training run completed, cycle not yet active.

_variant_model_file_missing._comment: Model is trained and in memory, but the .ser file was deleted from disk. The current session works normally but the model will not survive a restart.
